description: This file defines a PHP class `SubscriptionStatus` for managing subscription statuses in the OpenCart admin localization module. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting subscription status records, along with rendering corresponding views and handling form submissions.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription statuses, including listing, editing, saving, and deleting subscription status entities within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language and sets page title; prepares breadcrumbs and view data; renders the main subscription status listing page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches the list of subscription statuses with sorting, ordering, pagination, and renders the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs the data for listing subscription statuses, including sorting, filtering, pagination, and returns the rendered list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles rendering the form for adding or editing a subscription status, including setting up data and permissions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to add or update a subscription status, performs validation, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription statuses based on submitted data, with permission check, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected subscription status records, including permission verification and returning a JSON response indicating success or errors.
